tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Use first to learn what Rendlet can render and which tools are free. Inputs: none. Output: JSON listing tools, input modes (HTML, built-in invoice/itinerary templates), page sizes, limits per plan, auth method and links. Cost: free, no key.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use when the user asks about price, hits a quota, or needs more documents. Inputs: none. Output: JSON with the free key, monthly plans with Stripe links, prepaid credit packs with Stripe Payment Links, the USDC-on-Base purchase endpoint and steps, and the cost of each tool. Cost: free, no key.

tools.name: preview_pdf
tools.description: Use to show what a document will look like before paying or signing up. Inputs: optional "html" (string, up to 50 KB; omit to preview the built-in sample invoice). Output: a 1-page low-resolution, PREVIEW-watermarked PDF (rasterized first A4 page) as an embedded base64 resource. Not for production u

tools.name: html_to_pdf
tools.description: Use to produce a real, full-quality PDF from HTML (reports, receipts, letters). Inputs: "html" (required), "format" (A4|Letter|Legal|A3|A5), "landscape", "margin" (CSS length), "filename". tools.description: Use when you have structured data for an invoice or travel itinerary and want a clean PDF without writing HTML. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "html_to_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
